gui.telecom.microwave.title: Microwave Dish (FH)
gui.telecom.microwave.name: Name
gui.telecom.microwave.target_x_hint: Peer block X in this dimension. Maximum distance: 4096 blocks. Fill all three coordinates or clear all three.
gui.telecom.microwave.target_y_hint: Peer block Y within this dimension's build height. No remote chunks are loaded.
gui.telecom.microwave.target_z_hint: Peer block Z in this dimension. The peer must point back to this dish; configure both ends separately.
gui.telecom.microwave.pairing_hint: Only this dish is changed. Configure the other dish separately with reciprocal coordinates, matching channel and frequency, and enable both ends.
gui.telecom.microwave.aim_hint: Calculate this dish's azimuth and elevation toward the typed coordinates. Updates the local draft only; Save to apply. Does not aim or configure the peer.
gui.telecom.microwave.channel_hint: Whole number from 1 to 16. Both dishes must use the same channel and frequency.
gui.telecom.microwave.azimuth_hint: Whole degrees: 0 south (+Z), 90 west (-X), 180 north (-Z), 270 east (+X).
gui.telecom.microwave.elevation_hint: Whole degrees from -90 to 90; positive points up, negative down. 0 is horizontal.
gui.telecom.microwave.save_hint: Save this dish only. Live status never overwrites unsaved edits. Pairing at the other end must be configured separately.
gui.telecom.microwave.invalid: Invalid name, coordinates or radio values.
gui.telecom.microwave.local_only: Only this dish will be changed.
gui.telecom.antenna.title: Antenna Configuration
gui.telecom.antenna.name: Name
gui.telecom.antenna.sectors_hint: 0: all directions. 1, 2 or 3 directional sectors, equally spaced around the site. The azimuth sets the first sector's direction. Sectors share the site's capacity per band; adding sectors does not multiply it.
gui.telecom.antenna.azimuth_hint: First sector's direction in whole degrees: 0 = south (+Z), 90 = west (-X), 180 = north (-Z), 270 = east (+X). Ignored for omni coverage.
gui.telecom.antenna.tilt_hint: Vertical tilt in whole degrees. Positive points down, negative points up. 0 is horizontal; allowed range -15 to 45. Ignored for omni coverage.
gui.telecom.antenna.power_hint: Transmit power in whole dBm, from 0 to 50. 30 dBm is the calibrated reference. Higher power improves signal, not nominal band capacity.
gui.telecom.antenna.bandwidth_hint: Choose 25%, 50% or 100% of each band's reference channel width, not MHz. Reference: 2G 0.2 MHz, 3G 5 MHz, 4G 20 MHz, 5G 100 MHz (26 GHz: 400 MHz). Narrower channels reduce nominal capacity. Defaults work without expert tuning.
gui.telecom.antenna.band_hint: Reference width: %s MHz. Selected: %s%% = %s MHz. Capacity is shared by all sectors of the site.
gui.telecom.antenna.shared: Sectors share site capacity per band.
gui.telecom.antenna.shared_hint: Save name, enabled bands and radio settings. All sectors share the site's nominal capacity per band. Live telemetry does not overwrite unsaved edits.
gui.telecom.antenna.invalid: Enter whole numbers in the shown ranges.

gui.telecom.server.title: Telecom Server

gui.telecom.speedtest.error.session_limi: Too many tests running; try again later
gui.telecom.speedtest.error.route_lost: Network route lost during the test
gui.telecom.speedtest.error.catalogue_li: Server catalogue too large; reduce the network size
gui.telecom.speedtest.error.network_limi: Physical path budget exceeded; reduce the network size
gui.telecom.speedtest.error.radio_lost: Radio connection unavailable or lost; move within coverage and retry
gui.telecom.speedtest.error.radio_unknow: Radio path unknown: terrain data unavailable; retry when terrain is loaded
gui.telecom.speedtest.error.radio_limit: Radio scan limit reached; reduce nearby antennas or the network size
screen.telecom.map.title: Network Map
screen.telecom.map.antenna_hint: Click an antenna to select it. Click again or use this button for all antennas. Right-drag to pan.
screen.telecom.map.custom_y_hint: Custom receiver Y (integer). Choose Custom Y with the Height button to edit. Values outside the world's height are rejected.
screen.telecom.map.precision_hint: Requested grid: 1, 8 or 16 blocks. The effective grid coarsens when zooming out to keep at most 16 tiles and 16 x 16 cells per tile. Zoom in for finer sampling.
screen.telecom.map.navigation: Zoom: %sx | Nodes: %s | Drag / scroll to navigate
screen.telecom.map.status.limited: Calculation limit reached. Select one antenna or a coarser grid; for a topology limit, reduce the network size. Toggle coverage to retry.
screen.telecom.map.status.invalid: Invalid request; change the view or filters
screen.telecom.map.legend.unknown: Unknown signal (terrain or receiver height unavailable)
message.telecom.radio_limit: Radio scan limit reached; reduce nearby antennas or the network size
